statement: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpabf20644.features3bde51 TBLPROPERTIES (delta.enableChangeDataFeed = true) AS WITH tx AS (SELECT CAST(row_id AS STRING) row_id, CAST(account_id AS STRING) account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) event_time, CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) amount, CAST(currency AS STRING) currency FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabf20644/raw3bde51/transactions.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)), fx AS (SELECT CAST(currency AS STRING) currency, CAST(fx_rate AS DOUBLE) fx_rate FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabf20644/raw3bde51/fx_rates.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)) SELECT t.row_id, t.account_id, t.event_time, t.amount * f.fx_rate AS amount_usd, CAST(CASE WHEN (FLOOR(t.event_time / 86400000) % 7) IN (2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS is_weekend, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_7d FROM tx t JOIN fx f ON t.currency = f.currency
